points.text: F is benzaldehyde: $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CHO}$ as phenyl ring bonded to $\text{CH(O)}$
G is benzyl benzoate: $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COOCH}_2\text{C}_6\text{H}_5$ as benzoate phenyl bonded to $\text{C(=O)-O-CH}_2$-phenyl
F with aldehydic H circled labelled $\delta$ 10.0 ; G with benzylic $\text{H}_2$ circled labelled $\delta$ 5.1
methylphenoxide anion has delocalisation of the lone pair on oxygen over the ring
benzoic acid has an (extra) electronegative oxygen or electron withdrawing $\text{C=O}$
step 1 treat benzoic acid with $\text{SOCl}_2$ or $\text{PCl}_5$ to make the acyl chloride
step 2 dissolve the methylphenol in $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ (and shake with the benzoyl chloride)
